subject: Vendor setup & billing path options for ScoutX Labs
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@scoutxlabs.com>, Alyssa Kim <alyssa.kim@scoutxlabs.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Post-demo: vendor setup & billing path options for ScoutX Labs

Thanks for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so procurement has what they need to decide on PO vs card and marketplace onboarding:

What we covered
- Platform fit: Redwood inference hosted API + option for Dedicated later; you confirmed core use-case (real-time inference for chat assistant).
- Commercial preferences: Finance prefers purchase order path if possible; also interested in marketplace option if it reduces procurement paperwork.
- Security/compliance: you requested SOC 2 summary, vendor onboarding form, and sample contract language for PO acceptance.

Documents attached to help procurement: redwood-SOC2-summary-2026.pdf, redwood-vendor-onboarding-form.xlsx (vendor setup + W-9 placeholder).

Next steps (proposed)
1) You: confirm who owns the vendor setup in ScoutX (procurement@scoutxlabs.com or a specific contact) and whether net terms are required (e.g., Net30).
2) We: fill the onboarding form and return W-9 + sample SOW/contract (I'll coordinate with finance).
3) Finance alignment: internal check on invoice cadence and pre-approved credit (if any) to avoid service interruptions during onboarding.
4) Marketplace: let us know if AWS Marketplace is preferred — we can provide listing info and procurement-friendly SKU details.

Proposed timeline: vendor form + docs returned by Tue (Aug 2) -> procurement confirmation by end of week -> contract routing/DocuSign the following week.

If helpful, happy to set a 20-minute procurement sync with your procurement lead and our finance ops.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov | Senior Commercial Lead
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0143

Thanks, Olga — appreciate the clear recap. A few quick answers from procurement side:

- We own vendor setup at procurement@scoutxlabs.com; Alyssa is the primary owner for vendor paperwork.
- ScoutX's standard is PO + Net30 for contracted services. Finance will need a completed vendor form + W-9 and our legal team will route a short SOW.
- Marketplace: interested in AWS Marketplace if you support private offers (that can speed the process). If not, PO is fine.

Can you confirm whether Redwood needs a pre-pay or a credit check to go live? Also any minimum invoice amounts or initial commit?

Jordan
Jordan Patel
Head of Platform Partnerships, ScoutX Labs

- Standard timeline to approve a new vendor and start accepting PO?

Thanks for the heads up, Olga. Quick finance check:

- We can accept PO + Net30 for ScoutX. No prepay required for commercial deals under $50k ARR, but we'll ask for a first invoice within 30 days of go-live.
- Vendor onboarding: we need the completed onboarding form + W-9 + primary billing contact. Once received, we can set up a vendor record in our AP system (takes ~3 business days).
- Marketplace private offers: we can support configuring SKU pricing for Marketplace private offers; ops will want a sample invoice mapping and the Marketplace product ID.

I'll draft a concise "procurement-ready package" (onboarding form, W-9, sample invoice mapping, and suggested PO acceptance clause) and send it back to you by EOD Wed. That should make it straightforward for Jordan/Alyssa to submit their PO.

Ben
